intro: No MBA / PGDM college in Rajasthan in our records has a 2020-or-later non-executive highest package of ₹{{threshold}} lakh or more. This page still lists the highest recorded packages in the state, with flagship programmes preferred.

These MBA colleges in Rajasthan with ₹50 lakh highest package should be read that way. IIM Udaipur leads the top MBA colleges in Rajasthan 2026 on its official 2025 two-year MBA report, but that official highest domestic figure is ₹47.65 LPA, just below this cut.
listLead: IIM Udaipur is 21st in the official NIRF 2025 Management ranking. Its official IPRS-audited Two-Year MBA Placement Report for the 2023-25 batch lists a mean maximum earning potential of ₹17.59 LPA, a median of ₹17 LPA, and a highest domestic figure of ₹47.65 LPA.
snapshot: Because no college crosses ₹{{threshold}} lakh in our 2020-or-later non-executive records, the list of {{count}} colleges is sorted by the highest recorded package instead.

Some private-college cards still show 2023 highs close to this threshold, such as Jaipur Engineering College & Research Centre at ₹44 LPA beside an average of ₹5 LPA. Those recorded gaps are wide and should be checked in each official report.
firstCollegesLead: Older Arya College and Udai Institute records that once appeared to clear this cut are no longer used, because no official report was found to support those headline figures.
Start any serious Rajasthan MBA shortlist with IIM Udaipur and the official NIRF 2025 Management list, then confirm each college's latest official placement report.

compare.heading: How to read highest-package figures in Rajasthan
paragraphs: A threshold page with no college above ₹{{threshold}} lakh is still useful if the top official figures are shown clearly. IIM Udaipur's official 2025 highest domestic package is ₹47.65 LPA, not ₹50 lakh or more.
bullets: Use the official IIM Udaipur 2025 mean of ₹17.59 LPA and median of ₹17 LPA beside the highest domestic figure of ₹47.65 LPA.
Treat a private-college highest package beside a much lower average as a figure that needs official confirmation.
Do not use the older, unverified Arya College or Udai Institute highs that were removed from this list.

faqs.question: Do any MBA colleges in Rajasthan have a ₹50 lakh highest package in this file?
faqs.answer: No. In our 2020-or-later non-executive records, no Rajasthan MBA college reaches ₹{{threshold}} lakh. The list instead shows the highest recorded packages in the state.

faqs.question: What is IIM Udaipur's official 2025 highest package?
faqs.answer: The official IPRS-audited Two-Year MBA Placement Report for the 2023-25 batch lists a highest domestic maximum earning potential of ₹47.65 LPA, a mean of ₹17.59 LPA and a median of ₹17 LPA.

faqs.question: Why is IIM Udaipur not above this ₹50 lakh cut?
faqs.answer: Its official 2025 highest domestic figure is ₹47.65 LPA, which is below ₹{{threshold}} lakh. It remains the leading recorded figure on this page and is 21st in the official NIRF 2025 Management ranking.

faqs.question: Are the older Arya College or Udai Institute figures still used?
faqs.answer: No. Those unverified records are no longer used, because no official placement report was found to support them.
